name: ISO 27017
description: Cloud controls that sit on top of ISO 27002. Titles name the topic. Descriptions are our own short guidance, not the standard's text.

requirements.title: Cloud service controls
requirements.summary: Controls that apply because the service runs on cloud infrastructure shared with other customers.

children.title: Shared roles and responsibilities
children.summary: Write down which security duties belong to the cloud customer and which belong to each cloud provider.

children.title: Removal of customer assets
children.summary: When a customer leaves, return or delete their data and show that the copies are gone.

children.title: Separation between customers
children.summary: Keep one customer's data and compute from being reached by another customer.

children.title: Hardening of virtual machines
children.summary: Start virtual machines from a hardened image and keep that image current.

children.title: Administrator operations
children.summary: Limit who can administer the cloud service, and record what those administrators do.

children.title: Monitoring of the cloud service
children.summary: Collect logs from each cloud and review them often enough to notice a problem.

children.title: Virtual and physical networks
children.summary: Match the virtual network controls to the physical network the cloud provider runs.
